notes.title: Game engine update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

I have updated the game engine ( UE 4.27 ) and this should fix those Wind 11 crashes.
But, because the DLC functionality relied on a old plugin, this is causing problems if you want to play the game with the DLC enabled. 
So, I have created another branch, called "[b]old_game_and_dlc[/b]" and on that branch you can load the old version of the game, that is compatible with the DLC. 
On the main, [b]default[/b] branch, you can load the new game version, with Wind 11 compatibility. 
[b]On the main branch, you need to DISABLE the DLC in order for the game to launch.[/b]

To change branches, check this guide:  https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=487242306 . 

I have asked Steam to remove the DLC from the store ( players who already own it will still be able to play it ) in order to minimize confusion and streamline the process of playing the game. So, until Steam does that, I would recommend to not buy the DLC. I intend to add the DLC content to the main game in a short time anyway.

notes.title: Bug Fix and optimization Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, 

Today's update brings the latest bug fixes and optimization to the game. Now, the game should load faster and be lighter on memory ( RAM and VRAM). But, I had to change the folder structure a bit, and this will cause a heavy download for the update ( in my case it was around 800 MB ).

Bug fixes: 
Aiko's events were not showing in the Free Mode.
In some cases, the inventory didn't work after loading a saved game.

This should conclude this project. Maybe I will do another DLC in a couple of months, as I still have many ideas for more plots, but for the moment I need to focus on the other game that I have started. I am hoping to bring it to EA in 2-3 months from now.

Thank very much for your support and I hope you will enjoy Cyndy!

P.S. If you do find any other bugs, please report them and I will fix them ASAP.

notes.title: Cyndy 1.1 Update. A bugfix update and future plans
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

  I've got a quick update, bugs that have been reported after the launch.
  So here are the fixed issues:

-Police Station chat window;
-Video Tapes not being used in video projects;
-Score not being displayed when watching Kiara stripping ( there should not be a score displayed for Cyndy or Maddy, as there is no score required to interact with them);
-Fixed an issue that caused for the stripers to stay on stage the whole day, after a game load.

 Now, about the future of Cyndy and future plans:
- I plan another content update in 1, maybe 2 months. This update will feature more plots, I don't think I will add new mechanics, but who knows what sick ideas might go around in my brain. This plots will focus on Charlie, Eli, and Estrella, as I feel they were a bit left behind.
-I also started prototyping, and I have some good results whit it,  a new game, a Brothel simulator, where you will be able to manage a legal brothel. 
Game mechanics will include: hiring female workers, brothel staff, like security and bartenders; the better your workers are, the more clients you will have, also, you will be able to improve and expand your Brothel, and this, combined with the performance of your workers will affect your income.
Game graphics: I can't use real 3D models and animations, I'm just a lone wolf and as such, committing to a real 3D game, with the model quality that I would like, would make this a 2-3 years project and I can't do that. So, I have chosen a different path: 3D renders of even better quality than those made for Cyndy as I have upgraded my work station, combined with high-quality sprites and 2D high-quality animations.
I hope this sounds interesting to you, and if that is the case, you can follow my progress either by following me as a Dev on Steam, join my Discord: https://discord.gg/xjJWbuK  or at https://dreambiggame.com/  .
